name: php-mcp-server-generator
description: Generate a complete, production-ready PHP MCP server using the official PHP SDK, with tools, resources, prompts, and tests.

Ask for project name, server description, transport (stdio/http/both), tools, whether to include resources/prompts, and PHP version (8.2+ required). Generate the complete project from the answers.

Composer settings:
"name": "your-org/{project-name}",
"description": "{Server description}",
"optimize-autoloader": true,
"preferred-install": "dist",
"sort-packages": true

Use PHP 8.2 or higher. Follow PSR-12; use `declare(strict_types=1);` in all files; use PHP Attributes `#[McpTool]`, `#[McpResource]`, `#[McpPrompt]`, and `#[Schema]`; add PHPDoc to all methods; handle errors with specific exceptions and clear messages; write PHPUnit tests for all tools; always use PSR-16 cache for discovery in production.

Server: require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php'; use Mcp\Server, Mcp\Server\Transport\StdioTransport, Symfony\Component\Cache\Adapter\FilesystemAdapter, Symfony\Component\Cache\Psr16Cache. Configure discovery cache with `new Psr16Cache(new FilesystemAdapter('mcp-discovery', 3600, __DIR__ . '/cache'))`; build with `Server::builder()->setServerInfo('{Project Name}', '1.0.0')`; discovery `excludeDirs: ['vendor', 'tests', 'cache']`; stdio: `$transport = new StdioTransport(); $server->run($transport);`. Support requested transport(s).

Provide tool examples: `greet(string $name): string` returns `"Hello, {$name}!"`; `performCalculation(...)` supports arithmetic, throwing `\InvalidArgumentException('Division by zero')` and `\InvalidArgumentException('Invalid operation')` as appropriate. Include examples as applicable: `simpleAction(string $input): string` returns `"Processed: {$input}"`; email validation via `filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL) !== false`; `enum Status: string { case ACTIVE = 'active'; case INACTIVE = 'inactive'; }`; `setStatus(string $id, Status $status): array` returns `['id' => $id, 'status' => $status->value]`; settings returns `['key' => 'value']`; user lookup returns `$this->users[$id] ?? throw new \RuntimeException('User not found')`.

Optional resources: config resource `uri: 'config://app/settings'`, `name: 'app_config'`, `mimeType: 'application/json'`, returns array; template `uriTemplate: 'data://{category}/{id}'`, `name: 'data_resource'`, `mimeType: 'application/json'`, returns `['data' => "Sample data for {$category}/{$id}"]`.

Optional prompts: code review prompt defaults focus to `'general'`, includes expert-reviewer guidance and asks to review the supplied language/code/focus; documentation prompt `generateDocs(string $code, string $style = 'detailed'): array` asks to generate documentation in the selected style.

Add PHPUnit tests for gr
